messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy request: hotfix/kvcache-ttl-fix -> production. Change window requested 2026-03-20 20:00-21:00 UTC. Image: rdlw-inference:v1.14.2+patch. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate >0.5% sustained 15m OR p95 latency >500ms. Approver list: @release-manager-bot, @sre-oncall, @paula. Please ack for expedited approval. https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/8765 (changelog attached)

maya: Ack from product. This is customer-facing tokenization error, high priority. :+1:

liam: SRE ack, oncall ok with expedited. I'll run preflight smoke at T-10.

alex: Quick note — pinning model shard set required. Confirming we pin to model-shard v2.3.1 to avoid runtime mismatch.

sre-oncall: Oncall confirms. Preflight checklist: health checks green, canary 2 pods in us-west2, tracing enabled, temporary circuit-breaker at 80% concurrency. I will monitor metrics channel.

paula: Release manager approves expedited deploy. Please include release note snippet: "kvcache TTL regression fix — prevents cache evictions causing tokenization failures for long sequences."

maya: One ask — during rollout please disable background indexing job on prod to reduce noise: feature-flag indexer.enable=false.

liam: Doing canary now (deployctl promote --image rdlw-inference:v1.14.2+patch --canary 2). Logs: ```Deploy started: canary pods creating...
Pod kvcache-canary-1 Ready
Pod kvcache-canary-2 Ready
Smoke: /health -> 200 OK
Trace sampling active
```

alex: Observability looks good so far. p95 latency unchanged, 5xx = 0.02% over last 5m. No obvious memory regressions in heap.

sre-oncall: Traffic shift to 20% canary for 10m. Will revert instantly if triggers hit.

deploy-bot: Canary at 20% complete. No trigger hits. Ready to roll to 100% on approval.

paula: Approve rollout to 100% now. Noting change window and customer impact.

maya: Approve. :white_check_mark:

liam: Rolling to 100% (deployctl rollout --to 100 --image rdlw-inference:v1.14.2+patch). Will monitor for 15m post-rollout.

release-manager-bot: Rollout started by liam. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/deploys/9876. Notifying stakeholders.

sre-oncall: 5m post-rollout: 5xx = 0.03%, p95 = 180ms. No customer complaints on frontlines. Continuing 15m watch.

alex: Confirming model shard pinned and no version skew in logs: "model-shard=v2.3.1" present on all nodes.

liam: 15m check complete. Metrics stable. Closing expedited window. Leaving postmortem notes in release doc.

paula: Thanks team. I'll publish a short release note and mark this hotfix as "expedited, customer-impacting — resolved".

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. Deployed rdlw-inference:v1.142+patch -> production. If rollback required run: `deployctl rollback --to previous` or revert image to rdlw-inference:v1.14.1.
